Name: Seed Limiter
Author: kurtsietz
Description:
Seed Limiter allows you to play on a limited list of Seeds instead of a truly random seed. You can use Seed Finder to create different gameplay scenarios.

When you create a new game it will only use the seeds in the seeds.txt file.

I included a seed list where dish of the day appears on day 1 as an example. it has 42,000 seeds. Please note that the mod is about Seed Limiting not about this seed list, so if there's any errors in the seed list (the seed not having dish of the day on day 1) I apologize.

Manifest.Name: Seed Limiter
Manifest.Description: Restrict new game world seeds to a curated list.
